pagines.c: Compromiso del club · LOPIVI Un entorno seguro para cada niño y cada niña El baloncesto enseña a competir, pero en el Barna la primera regla es otra: aquí ninguna criatura queda desprotegida · Así lo garantizamos, por ley y por convicción propia · También disponible en: català · English Qué es la LOPIVI La Ley Orgánica 8/2021 de protección integral a la infancia y la adolescencia (LOPIVI) obliga a cualquier entidad que trabaje con menores —clubes deportivos incluidos— a tener un protocolo de protección escrito, una persona delegada con formación específica y un canal para que cualquier situación de riesgo se pueda comunicar con confianza · No es un trámite administrativo: es el marco legal que hace que un club sea un lugar seguro, no solo un lugar donde se juega bien al baloncesto · Cómo lo cumplimos en el CB Grup Barna ✓ Protocolo propio aprobado por la junta ✓ Delegada de Protección al

pagines.t: T1 · The Invisible Market · Barna Method · CB Grup Barna
pagines.d: The Invisible Market theory: female talent exists, but the system does not price it. Formulated in CB Grup Barna's academic research (2026).
h: Female talent as an unpriced asset.
The WNBA explosion: the invisible market is revealed.
pagines.c: → Home · The 5 Theories · T1 · Invisible Market Theory 1 · Research framework The Invisible Market · Female talent exists, it generates value, but the system does not measure it correctly · When a club corrects the undervaluation, it captures a surplus the rest of the market cannot see · The first hidden pattern Female talent as an unpriced asset · Grassroots women's basketball operates as an invisible market : it exists, it generates value, but it is not priced · The 157,432 women with a federation licence in Spain (35.7% of the total) represent an asset the system systematically undervalues · Not because it is worth less, but because nobody measures it correctly · When a club assigns 65% of its budget to the men's side, it is not doing so from performance analysis but from inertia · The men's side has always had more; therefore, it "deserves" more · This is a cognitive bias called anch

The best protection for the Method is the threshold.

Build the system · the target defines itself.
pagines.c: → Home · The 5 Theories · T5 · Productive Authenticity Theory 5 · Research framework Productive Authenticity · Organisations that practise their values generate an organic response that outperforms any planned strategy · 53.7% female audience, with no campaign at all · The fifth hidden pattern The 53.7%: the anomaly that points to a new theory · 53.7% of CB Grup Barna's social media audience are women · In grassroots basketball, where digital audiences are usually 60-70% male, this is a statistical anomaly · And anomalies are where science finds new theories · Three explanatory hypotheses: H1 Structural hypothesis: 50% of the teams are women's teams, so the visual content naturally reflects parity · H2 Community hypothesis: with 20 women's teams, the number of mothers, sisters and friends is proportionally higher · H3 Authenticity hypothesis: women detect that the club practises equality
